description: This file defines the FileCookieJar class responsible for persisting non-session cookies to a JSON-formatted file, including methods for saving and loading cookie data, and handling file operations.

classes.name: FileCookieJar
classes.description: A class extending CookieJar to persist cookies to a file, with functionalities to load and save cookies as JSON, controlling persistence of session cookies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FileCookieJar, optionally loading existing cookies from a specified file.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Automatically saves cookies upon object destruction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes cookies into JSON and writes them to the specified file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from a JSON file into the jar, with error handling for invalid data.
